reported.title: Incorrect debounce timing
reported.description: The debounce time is set to 12 ms, which is insufficient to handle contact bounce of up to 8 ms. This could lead to multiple triggers being registered from a single press.

reported.title: Timing issue with valve opening
reported.description: The valve opening logic does not account for the time taken to process the loop, which could lead to the valve opening later than 100 ms after the press.

truth.description: The close time is stored as an absolute millis() value, so a burst that starts within 400 ms of the 32-bit rollover closes at once

truth_for_judge.description: The close time is stored as an absolute millis() value, so a burst that starts within 400 ms of the 32-bit rollover closes at once

exposing_checks.behaviour: D8 pulse length around None ms (tolerance 80 ms) (A press opens the valve for 400 ms)

judge_input.spec:
- Spray valve relay on D8; trigger button on D2 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D2 opens the valve (D8 HIGH) for 400 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 8 ms on press and release must not start a second burst.
- Presses while the valve is open are ignored and do not extend it.
- The valve stays closed (D8 LOW) whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `spray n=<count> open=<0|1>` every 1000 ms.
